classes.name: banking product
classes.label: banking product
classes.definition: A retail financial product managed in the catalog and made available for customer sale/advice, e.g. cards, loans, deposits, payment accounts, or attached insurance. [AI-sales projection] Recommendation/advice uses only Published products that are currently effective and pass eligibility.

classes.name: product offer
classes.label: product offer
classes.definition: A sale-specific offer attached to exactly one BankingProduct, with price/discount/benefit, conditions and validity.

classes.name: campaign
classes.label: campaign
classes.definition: A time-bound sales/marketing campaign that groups products/offers, targets segments/needs and carries campaign benefits and budget.

classes.name: product category
classes.label: product category
classes.definition: Managed classification/taxonomy concept used to organize products and support filtering, semantic grouping and inheritance.

classes.name: customer segment
classes.label: customer segment
classes.definition: A reusable customer grouping used to target products/offers/campaigns and prioritize recommendations.

classes.name: customer need
classes.label: customer need
classes.definition: A reusable business concept representing a customer need used to match and prioritize products/offers/campaigns.

classes.name: business rule
classes.label: business rule
classes.definition: A governed, versioned business rule representing eligibility, sales condition or policy logic with applicability scope and priority.

classes.name: sales script
classes.label: sales script
classes.definition: Governed sales/advisory script for a situation, including opening, objection handling and closing, attachable to product/offer/campaign.

classes.name: sales skill
classes.label: sales skill
classes.definition: Governed AI sales capability/skill content containing guidance, process and instructions associated with products or product classifications.

classes.name: sales knowledge
classes.label: sales knowledge
classes.definition: Governed knowledge asset such as FAQ, article, document, guide or sales playbook used to answer product questions.

classes.name: required document
classes.label: required document
classes.definition: A required document concept describing the type of evidence a customer must provide, including copy count and validity condition.

classes.name: product bundle
classes.label: product bundle
classes.definition: A managed grouping of at least two effective BankingProducts intended to be sold together.

classes.name: approval task
classes.label: approval task
classes.definition: Governance record for approval of a catalog object, including approval chain, approver, comment, status and history.

classes.name: version
classes.label: version
classes.definition: A version record of a managed catalog object, capturing creator, time, changes and description for compare/rollback.

classes.name: customer
classes.label: customer
classes.definition: Customer entity whose current segment, needs, behavior context and current products provide the context for recommendation.

edges.name: has offer
edges.label: has offer
edges.definition: Links a product to its sale offer(s). [Business constraint] Every ProductOffer must be linked to exactly one BankingProduct (BR-03).

edges.name: in campaign
edges.label: in campaign
edges.definition: Links a product directly to a campaign in which it participates. [Business constraint] Campaign must be active to be used for sales (BR-02).

edges.name: offer in campaign
edges.label: offer in campaign
edges.definition: Links an offer to the campaign(s) in which it is used. [Business constraint] Campaign and Offer must both be usable/active for sales.

edges.name: classified as
edges.label: classified as
edges.definition: Assigns a product to one or more managed product classifications.

edges.name: targets segment
edges.label: targets segment
edges.definition: Indicates a customer segment for which a product is targeted/relevant.

edges.name: satisfies need
edges.label: satisfies need
edges.definition: Links a product to customer needs it is intended to satisfy.

edges.name: campaign targets segment
edges.label: campaign targets segment
edges.definition: Targets a campaign to one or more customer segments. [Business constraint] Segment must be valid when campaign is published (workflow §9.4).

edges.name: campaign targets need
edges.label: campaign targets need
edges.definition: Targets a campaign to one or more customer needs.

edges.name: offer targets segment
edges.label: offer targets segment
edges.definition: Links an offer to the segment(s) it targets.

edges.name: offer addresses need
edges.label: offer addresses need
edges.definition: Links an offer to needs for which its proposition is relevant.

edges.name: has eligibility rule
edges.label: has eligibility rule
edges.definition: Attaches eligibility rules to a product; target rules must have ruleType=ELIGIBILITY. [Business constraint] Target BusinessRule.ruleType = ELIGIBILITY; must evaluate before recommendation (BR-08).

edges.name: has sales condition rule
edges.label: has sales condition rule
edges.definition: Attaches sales-condition rules to a product. [Business constraint] Target BusinessRule.ruleType = SALES_CONDITION.

edges.name: governed by policy
edges.label: governed by policy
edges.definition: Attaches policy-type BusinessRules to a product. [Business constraint] Target BusinessRule.ruleType = POLICY.

edges.name: offer has rule
edges.label: offer has rule
edges.definition: Attaches offer-specific eligibility/sales/policy rules to an offer.

edges.name: campaign has rule
edges.label: campaign has rule
edges.definition: Attaches rules governing campaign applicability or operation.

edges.name: rule applies to segment
edges.label: rule applies to segment
edges.definition: Limits or scopes a business rule to one or more customer segments.

edges.name: has script
edges.label: has script
edges.definition: Links a product to approved sales scripts applicable to it. [Business constraint] Sales content may only be used after approval and publish (BR-15).

edges.name: offer has script
edges.label: offer has script
edges.definition: Links a sales script directly to a specific offer. [Business constraint] Sales content must be approved/published (BR-15).

edges.name: campaign has script
edges.label: campaign has script
edges.definition: Links a campaign to campaign-specific sales scripts. [Business constraint] Campaign active; Script approved/published.

edges.name: has skill
edges.label: has skill
edges.definition: Links a product to sales skills/capabilities relevant to advising on it. [Business constraint] Skill must be approved/published before use (BR-15).

edges.name: has knowledge
edges.label: has knowledge
edges.definition: Links product to FAQ/article/document/playbook knowledge assets. [Business constraint] Knowledge must be approved/published before use (BR-15/20).

edges.name: requires document
edges.label: requires document
edges.definition: Links a product to documents the customer must provide. [Business constraint] Applies only for published, active Product (BR-14); document content approved/published (BR-15).

edges.name: document has rule
edges.label: document has rule
edges.definition: Links required-document semantics to rules that validate/apply to the requirement.

edges.name: uses skill
edges.label: uses skill
edges.definition: Links a sales script to supporting AI sales skills.

edges.name: cross sell with
edges.label: cross sell with
edges.definition: Indicates products that may be proposed as complementary cross-sell candidates from a source product. [Business constraint] Evaluate relationship.condition; source != target (BR-12); target must be active and customer eligible before recommendation.

edges.name: upsell to
edges.label: upsell to
edges.definition: Indicates a higher-tier or enhanced product that can be offered as an upgrade from the source product. [Business constraint] Evaluate relationship.condition; source != target (BR-12); target active, eligible and need-fit.

edges.name: substitute for
edges.label: substitute for
edges.definition: Indicates a product that can substitute for another product. [Business constraint] Use relationship.condition; direction determined by configured relationship semantics.

edges.name: complements
edges.label: complements
edges.definition: Represents a product-product complementary relationship separate from a sales recommendation policy. [Business constraint] Direction follows relationship.direction; relationship.condition may constrain applicability.

edges.name: excludes
edges.label: excludes
edges.definition: Represents a product-product exclusion/incompatibility relationship. [Business constraint] Direction follows relationship.direction; condition may specify when exclusion applies.

edges.name: part of bundle
edges.label: part of bundle
edges.definition: Links a product to a bundle that contains it. [Business constraint] Bundle must contain at least two effective products (BR-13).

edges.name: in segment
edges.label: in segment
edges.definition: Represents customer membership in one or more segments used by recommendation.

edges.name: has need
edges.label: has need
edges.definition: Represents current customer needs relevant to the sales conversation.

edges.name: currently uses
edges.label: currently uses
edges.definition: Links a customer to products currently used/held, as recommendation context.

edges.name: recommended product
edges.label: recommended product
edges.definition: Derived/ephemeral relationship representing a ranked recommended product for a customer context. [Business constraint] Candidate must be active/published, eligible, and evaluated with segment/need/current product/campaign context.

edges.name: has version
edges.label: has version
edges.definition: Links a versioned managed catalog object to its Version records for provenance, history, comparison and rollback. [Business constraint] Published changes create a new version; only one published/effective version is current for an object (BR-06/09).

edges.name: has approval task
edges.label: has approval task
edges.definition: Links a Version to approval task(s)/steps governing that version before publish. [Business constraint] Approval precedes publish; creator cannot be final approver; AI uses only approved/published content (BR-01/19/20).

attributes.name: product code
attributes.label: product code
attributes.definition: Unique catalog code identifying a banking product. [Business constraint] BR-11: unique across the system.

attributes.name: name
attributes.label: name
attributes.definition: Human-readable product name.

attributes.name: product classification
attributes.label: product classification
attributes.definition: Classification/type assigned to the product.

attributes.name: price
attributes.label: price
attributes.definition: Product price or pricing value where applicable.

attributes.name: fee
attributes.label: fee
attributes.definition: Fee associated with the product where applicable.

attributes.name: version number
attributes.label: version number
attributes.definition: Version identifier/number for the product definition. [Business constraint] BR-06: published object changes require a new version; BR-09: only one published effective version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.label: status
attributes.definition: Lifecycle/publish status controlling whether the product can be used for selling. [Business constraint] BR-01/04/20: only approved→published, active data may be used for AI sales.

attributes.name: effective from
attributes.label: effective from
attributes.definition: Start date/time of product sales validity. [Business constraint] BR-10: effectiveTo must be after effectiveFrom.

attributes.name: effective to
attributes.label: effective to
attributes.definition: End date/time of product sales validity. [Business constraint] BR-04/10/20: product must still be effective; effectiveTo > effectiveFrom.

attributes.name: product attributes
attributes.label: product attributes
attributes.definition: Product-type-specific attributes not yet normalized by BA.

attributes.name: price
attributes.label: price
attributes.definition: Offer-specific sale price/value.

attributes.name: discount
attributes.label: discount
attributes.definition: Discount associated with the offer.

attributes.name: benefit
attributes.label: benefit
attributes.definition: Benefit or promotional value conveyed by the offer.

attributes.name: condition
attributes.label: condition
attributes.definition: Business condition text/summary specific to the offer.

attributes.name: effective from
attributes.label: effective from
attributes.definition: Start of offer validity.

attributes.name: effective to
attributes.label: effective to
attributes.definition: End of offer validity. [Business constraint] BR-10: end date after start date; active offer required for valid recommendation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.label: status
attributes.definition: Offer lifecycle/publish status. [Business constraint] BR-01/20: published data only.

attributes.name: version number
attributes.label: version number
attributes.definition: Offer version number.

attributes.name: name
attributes.label: name
attributes.definition: Campaign name.

attributes.name: objective
attributes.label: objective
attributes.definition: Campaign business objective.

attributes.name: effective from
attributes.label: effective from
attributes.definition: Campaign start date/time.

attributes.name: effective to
attributes.label: effective to
attributes.definition: Campaign end date/time. [Business constraint] BR-02/10: expired campaign not used; end after start.

attributes.name: campaign benefit
attributes.label: campaign benefit
attributes.definition: Campaign-level benefit/promotion.

attributes.name: budget
attributes.label: budget
attributes.definition: Campaign budget. [Business constraint] BR-16: do not exceed campaign budget; warn at threshold.

attributes.name: status
attributes.label: status
attributes.definition: Campaign lifecycle state. [Business constraint] BR-02/20: expired campaign cannot be used by AI Agent.

attributes.name: version number
attributes.label: version number
attributes.definition: Campaign version number.

attributes.name: category name
attributes.label: category name
attributes.definition: Human-readable product category label.

attributes.name: category code
attributes.label: category code
attributes.definition: Stable code for a managed product category.

attributes.name: parent category
attributes.label: parent category
attributes.definition: Parent category in a hierarchical taxonomy, if hierarchy is adopted.

attributes.name: segment name
attributes.label: segment name
attributes.definition: Human-readable label.

attributes.name: segment code
attributes.label: segment code
attributes.definition: Stable identifier/code.

attributes.name: segment description
attributes.label: segment description
attributes.definition: Business description.

attributes.name: need name
attributes.label: need name
attributes.definition: Human-readable label.

attributes.name: need code
attributes.label: need code
attributes.definition: Stable identifier/code.

attributes.name: need description
attributes.label: need description
attributes.definition: Business description.

attributes.name: rule type
attributes.label: rule type
attributes.definition: Rule semantic type. [Business constraint] BR-08: eligibility must be evaluated before recommendation.

attributes.name: condition
attributes.label: condition
attributes.definition: Business-language condition/logic represented by the rule.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.label: priority
attributes.definition: Priority used when multiple rules apply.

attributes.name: version number
attributes.label: version number
attributes.definition: Rule version number.

attributes.name: status
attributes.label: status
attributes.definition: Rule lifecycle/publish status. [Business constraint] BR-01/20: only approved/published usable data.

attributes.name: scenario
attributes.label: scenario
attributes.definition: Sales/advisory scenario the script addresses.

attributes.name: opening line
attributes.label: opening line
attributes.definition: Opening sales/advisory wording.

attributes.name: objection handling
attributes.label: objection handling
attributes.definition: Guidance/wording for handling objections.

attributes.name: closing line
attributes.label: closing line
attributes.definition: Closing wording or closing step.

attributes.name: version number
attributes.label: version number
attributes.definition: Sales script version number.

attributes.name: status
attributes.label: status
attributes.definition: Sales script lifecycle/publish status. [Business constraint] BR-15/20: script may be used only after approval/publish.

attributes.name: name
attributes.label: name
attributes.definition: Skill name.

attributes.name: description
attributes.label: description
attributes.definition: Skill description.

attributes.name: content
attributes.label: content
attributes.definition: Skill instructions/guidance content.

attributes.name: version number
attributes.label: version number
attributes.definition: Skill version number.

attributes.name: status
attributes.label: status
attributes.definition: Skill lifecycle/publish status. [Business constraint] BR-15/20: skill usable only after approval/publish.

attributes.name: knowledge type
attributes.label: knowledge type
attributes.definition: Type of knowledge asset.

attributes.name: tags
attributes.label: tags
attributes.definition: Tags/classification labels for knowledge search.

attributes.name: title
attributes.label: title
attributes.definition: Human-readable knowledge title.

attributes.name: content
attributes.label: content
attributes.definition: Knowledge content/body used by AI Agent.

attributes.name: version number
attributes.label: version number
attributes.definition: Knowledge asset version number.

attributes.name: status
attributes.label: status
attributes.definition: Knowledge asset lifecycle/publish status. [Business constraint] BR-15/20: knowledge/FAQ usable by AI only after approval/publish and while valid.

attributes.name: document type
attributes.label: document type
attributes.definition: Type/category of required document.

attributes.name: copy count
attributes.label: copy count
attributes.definition: Number of copies required.

attributes.name: validity condition
attributes.label: validity condition
attributes.definition: Condition that makes the document acceptable.

attributes.name: version number
attributes.label: version number
attributes.definition: Required-document definition version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.label: status
attributes.definition: Required-document lifecycle/publish status. [Business constraint] BR-14/15: applicable to published active product; content usable only after approval/publish.

attributes.name: document name
attributes.label: document name
attributes.definition: Human-readable required document label/description.

attributes.name: description
attributes.label: description
attributes.definition: Human-readable required document label/description.

attributes.name: bundle name
attributes.label: bundle name
attributes.definition: Human-readable bundle name.

attributes.name: bundle code
attributes.label: bundle code
attributes.definition: Stable bundle identifier.

attributes.name: status
attributes.label: status
attributes.definition: Bundle lifecycle/availability state. [Business constraint] BR-13: bundle contains at least two effective products.

attributes.name: approval chain
attributes.label: approval chain
attributes.definition: Approval chain/sequence for the task. [Business constraint] BR-01/19/20: approval before publish; creator cannot be final approver; AI uses approved data.

attributes.name: approver
attributes.label: approver
attributes.definition: Approver assigned to the task/step. [Business constraint] BR-01/19/20: approval before publish; creator cannot be final approver; AI uses approved data.

attributes.name: comment
attributes.label: comment
attributes.definition: Approval/rejection/change-request comment. [Business constraint] BR-01/19/20: approval before publish; creator cannot be final approver; AI uses approved data.

attributes.name: status
attributes.label: status
attributes.definition: Approval task/decision status. [Business constraint] BR-01/19/20: approval before publish; creator cannot be final approver; AI uses approved data.

attributes.name: approval history
attributes.label: approval history
attributes.definition: Approval decision/history records. [Business constraint] BR-01/19/20: approval before publish; creator cannot be final approver; AI uses approved data.

attributes.name: approval task id
attributes.label: approval task id
attributes.definition: Stable approval task identifier.

attributes.name: step order
attributes.label: step order
attributes.definition: Order of a step within the approval chain.

attributes.name: version number
attributes.label: version number
attributes.definition: Version identifier/number. [Business constraint] BR-06/09: published changes create new version; only one published effective version.

attributes.name: created by
attributes.label: created by
attributes.definition: Creator of the version. [Business constraint] BR-06/09: published changes create new version; only one published effective version.

attributes.name: created at
attributes.label: created at
attributes.definition: Time the version was created. [Business constraint] BR-06/09: published changes create new version; only one published effective version.

attributes.name: change
attributes.label: change
attributes.definition: Change details associated with the version. [Business constraint] BR-06/09: published changes create new version; only one published effective version.

attributes.name: description
attributes.label: description
attributes.definition: Version/change description or note. [Business constraint] BR-06/09: published changes create new version; only one published effective version.

attributes.name: is published version
attributes.label: is published version
attributes.definition: Marks a version as the published/current version. [Business constraint] BR-09: no two simultaneously published/effective versions for one product.

attributes.name: customer identifier
attributes.label: customer identifier
attributes.definition: Reference identifier for customer context supplied by an upstream system.

attributes.name: behavior context
attributes.label: behavior context
attributes.definition: Behavior information available in the recommendation context; structure is not defined by BA.
